acceptanceCriteria: The owner accepts or declines the amendment; if accepted, a follow-up implements it with the help tests updated.
body: V1-0945 cut root help from 11,710 to 3,967 bytes. The floor is set by accepted contracts: CCF-V1-008 requires a separate 936-byte `Command maturity:` section plus every verb under `Commands:`, and GPK-V0-059 requires every public verb in root help. Folding the maturity label into the Commands list (each verb named once) would reach about 1.8 KB. Acceptance of a contract amendment is human-owned, so this needs the owner. Coordinator decision recorded separately: context and query default limits stay unchanged (recall@10 is 0.07-0.37 below recall@20 in the frozen retrieval-bench runs; query default is byte-pinned by cli-parity) and plugins do not pass --limit 10. Found by the V1-0945 lane, 2026-10-07. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks build 202.
title: question: amend CCF-V1-008 so the Commands list carries the maturity label and root help reaches about 1.8 KB?
